Noah (Product): Quick internal announcement: extended model portfolio + unified stream-toolcall endpoint are rolling to Hosted API today. Expect gradual regional rollout over ~3 hours. TL;DR: more model options and a single streaming/tool-calling surface. :sparkles:

Ivy (Runtime): Nice. What exactly changed for callers?

Noah (Product): Two main items: 1) new models: atlas-7b-lite and atlas-13b-quant (verified for streaming). 2) endpoint /v1/stream/unified-toolcall that supports streaming, tool callbacks, and automatic fallback logic. Existing endpoints remain supported.

Omar (SRE): Rolling plan? Canary window and metrics to watch?

Noah (Product): Canary in us-east-1 for 30m, then staged ramp. Watch p95_stream_latency, unified.callback_errors, and model.variant_fallback_rate. Pager if fallback_rate > 3% sustained 5m.

DeployBot: deploy started: hosted-unified v2.0.0 -> canary(us-east-1) at 1851020500. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/hosted-unified/2.0.0

Ivy (Runtime): Runtime notes: atlas-13b-quant uses a low-precision path; we tuned KV-cache retention and soft-fallthrough to avoid first-token regressions. Unified endpoint multiplexes streaming frames and callback directives in a single SSE stream.

Priya (Docs): I need sample requests, cost notes, and a short migration snippet for customers using old toolcall endpoints. ETA?

Noah (Product): Sample streaming+callback curl below. Cost note: atlas-13b-quant priced ~30% cheaper per-token vs atlas-13b-rt (higher perf). Recommend routing_priority header for latency-sensitive routes.

Noah (Product): Example curl:
```
curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/unified-toolcall \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Routing: latency" \
  -d '{"model":"atlas-13b-quant","prompt":"Extract key points","tool_calling":"callbacks","callback_url":"https://hooks.example/receive","callback_timeout_ms":4000}'
```

Omar (SRE): New error codes to note: 4890 = unified.fallback (router triggered fallback to compatible variant), 4891 = unified.backpressure. Add to runbook and set alert: unified.backpressure > 2% for 10m -> page.

Ivy (Runtime): Ops note: we increased default connection pooling for unified workers and introduced a health probe that marks a model variant unhealthy on elevated OOM/retry alarms to enable faster routing away.

DeployBot: canary completed: hosted-unified v2.0.0 -> us-east-1 OK (1851021400). Next region rollout scheduled +20m.

Priya (Docs): I'll publish the quickstart, migration notes, and the pricing comparison table in ~90 minutes. Adding SDK examples for Node/Python.

Noah (Product): Thanks team. Please react with :thumbsup: once done. We'll post a brief public changelog entry after internal monitoring window (2 hours). If anything customer-impacting pops up, alert @oncall immediately.

Ivy (Runtime): :thumbsup:

Omar (SRE): :thumbsup:

Priya (Docs): :thumbsup:

Noah (Product): Rollout complete across regions at 1851023580. Closing thread; file a follow-up if you see anomalies.
